newsitem.title: UK: Vendome says current trade encouraging.
newsitem.headline: Vendome says current trade encouraging.

text.p: Vendome Luxury Group Plc said it has had an encouraging start to its current financial year.
"The first few months of the current year have shown continued growth in terms of local currencies," chairman and chief executive Joseph Kanoui told the group's annual meeting.
He said although the company had seen a fall in demand from the tourist markets of the Asia-Pacific region, which had affected luxury brands, gains in other markets had compensated.
The company's brands include Cartier, Mont Blanc and Alfred Dunhill.
